name: Stair Climbing

instructions.description: Stand at the base of the stairs and begin climbing at a controlled pace.
Place the whole foot on each step when possible and drive through the legs to ascend.
Use the handrail lightly if needed for balance but avoid pulling with the arms.
Descend carefully or take an elevator down if the focus is on the climbing work.

performanceMetrics.notes: Approximate vertical or horizontal distance if tracked.
Often reaches moderate to vigorous intensity.

variations.variationDescription: A more continuous locomotor progression of the step-up pattern.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Climb one flight and recover before repeating.

commentsNotes: Stop if dizziness or chest discomfort occurs.
